motto: Serbisyo sa Mamamayan, Malasakit Para sa Bayan
overview: Welcome to the official digital portal of the Municipality of Tanza, Cavite. Known as the 'Heart of the Cavite Coast', Tanza is a progressive 1st class municipality committed to transparent governance, digital transformation, and fast public service delivery for over 339,000 residents.

mayor.name: Hon. Archangelo B. Matro
mayor.title: Municipal Mayor
mayor.message: It is with pride and honor that we present the official digital portal of Tanza, Cavite. Embracing digital transformation is essential to delivering efficient and transparent public service. Through this portal, we provide timely, accurate, and accessible information that empowers every Tanzeño.
